me.title: My attendance
me.text: Check in when you start and out when you finish. Your days are worked out from your shift.
me.not_linked: Your login is not linked to an employee
me.not_linked_text: Ask HR to link your login to your employee record, then come back here.
me.no_punch: Checking in yourself is not available to you here. Your supervisor records your times.
me.offline_off: No network, and this phone is not set up for offline work. Try again when you are online.
me.kept_offline: No network: your check-in is kept on this phone and sent when you are online.
me.location_denied: Your location is needed to check in here. Allow location for this app and try again.
me.location_note: Your location is checked only when you tap, against your workplace.

correction.title: Ask to fix a day
correction.text: Give the time you came in and/or left, and why. Someone else decides.

drawer.void_text: It stays for the record but no longer counts. Say why.

today.title: Attendance
today.text: Who is in today at {unit} and the units below it.
today.empty_text: Employees hired in HRM at this unit appear here.

month.title: Month
month.text: Each person's days at {unit}. Open a day to see its punches.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.text: Forgotten or wrong punches. Approving turns the times into punches.
corrections.approve_text: The times become punches and the day is worked out again.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.text: Working hours of the company. An end at or before the start ends the next morning.
shifts.empty_text: Add the hours people work, then put them on a shift under Rosters.
shifts.name: Name

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.text: Days off of the company, or of one branch or department. Weekends come from the rules.
holidays.empty_text: Add public holidays and the company's own days off.
holidays.remove_text: The day becomes a working day again; its days are worked out again.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.only_here: Only for {unit} and the units below it

rosters.title: Rosters
rosters.text: Who works which shift at {unit}. Choose people, a shift and the day it starts.

portal.title: My attendance
portal.text: Your days as your employer records them.

locations.title: Workplaces
locations.text: Where people may check in from when their unit asks for a location check. A unit's workplaces count for the units below it.
locations.empty_text: Add the office, school or factory gate people check in at.
locations.required_on: People of {unit} must check in from a workplace (rule: location check).
locations.required_off: People of {unit} may check in from anywhere. Turn on the "location check" rule to use workplaces.
locations.name: Name
locations.use_here: Use where this device is now
locations.no_gps: This device cannot tell where it is. Type the latitude and longitude.
locations.gps_denied: Location was not allowed. Type the latitude and longitude instead.
locations.bad_point: Type the latitude and longitude as numbers, like 23.810331 and 90.412521.

device.title: Machine file
device.text: A CSV file exported from a fingerprint or card attendance machine. Times are local time.
device.sample: The first lines, as they will be read
device.not_employed: {count} lines fell on days the person was not employed.
